steps.text: If you want to do all 3 moons, you will need some barrows tank gear and a zombie axe

steps.title: Kill Amoxliatl or Frost Nagua for …
steps.text: Kill Amoxliatl or Frost Nagua for some Glacial temotli. — These can be stored in the Nest (nice) if you would like

steps.title: Kill the Blue Moon for the …
steps.text: Kill the Blue Moon for the full Blue moon armour
